preconditions.description: The number of steps n is a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in {'U', 'D'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s has length n, and each character is either 'U' (up) or 'D' (down).

postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated string of n integers, where the i-th integer is the duration of Olga's dream starting from step i (1-based), or -1 if she never falls.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= duration <= 2 * n + 1 or duration == -1 for duration in durations)
postconditions.description: Each duration is either -1 (infinite loop) or a positive integer representing the time until Olga falls, which is at most 2n + 1 seconds (upper bound for finite cases).

postconditions.expression: all(duration == -1 or (duration == simulate_fall(s, i) for i in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: For each step i, the duration is either -1 (Olga never falls) or the exact time it takes for Olga to fall starting from step i, computed by simulating the movement and pointer flips until she falls.
